body:
Tonight was the first time I tried Cocaine and it definitely seems different than what I am used to.  As some background, I generally smoke pot about twice a week and listen to some music as an effort to relax and take some stress off of the week.  I'm a Junior in College and I have tons of work with my double major (Mathematics and Biology).  Before trying pot I was a heavy social drinker, drinking between 3-8 beers twice a week (getting me anywhere from buzzed to quite inebriated).
After meeting several advocates of psychoactives I decided that I should try to experiment with different drugs to see how I enjoyed different highs.  I was given the perfect oppurtunity to do this over Winter Break, and the first druge I got my hands on was Cocaine.  I scored a gram for $50, which is supposedly a good price for where I live
.
After waiting an hour for my coworker's dealer to bring him some weed I finally got a chance to go home and try a line of my new substance.  I was pretty much just plain anxious before snorting what I deem a small line.  I've seen my brother do coke before and he always did about twice what I laid out.  I wanted to start small just to be on the safe side.  I put on some quiet music (Jewel/Pieces of You) and snorted my line through a McDonald's straw I had laying around.  The first thing I noticed was, well, nothing.  I know I wasn't smoking or freebasing, but I always heard about the instant high that all forms of coke provided.  That really didn't happen to me, and in fact coming up was really slow.  I didn't notice the exact second I felt any effects but I did feel the first piece of nasal drip numb my throat.
The high seemed pretty different from what I'm used to.  Instead of feeling like sitting around listening to music I started pacing the room and thinking ways I could describe what I was going through.  My mind was completely focused on trying to come up with an ingenuis way of describing my method of walking.  As far as energy goes, I felt like running up and down the street.  It was 11:30 at night but I felt like I woke up from a refreshing nap.  As far as feeling like king of the world for 15 minutes, that didn't happen either.  I simply had a rush of energy and was focused on the single 'most important' thing sitting  of my mind.  I still don't feel as if I've come down off of the initial energy rush (it is one hour later), so I am unable to comment on its addictive nature.
This is not anything near what I would describe pot; of course it isn't though-- pot is a psychotropic depressant and coke is a stimulant.  I don't know if this was anything near the high I was seeking (actually I am seeking more of a trip).  Of course, I knew that before I tried it by reading online
.  I shall continue onward toward my goal with other substances.
